title: Lightedge
summary: Lightedge is a unique spell that enhances the offensive power of a weapon. It is favored by Dellix who uses it to amplify the force and velocity of his sword.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Dellix used the spell in the Casterwill Library whilst fighting Lok Lambert, allowing Dellix to overpower the Willblade. Dellix later used it whilst fighting a Suit, enabling his sword to cut cleanly through an Organization Sedan. [Chasing Void]

During the battle outside the Fortress of Iron Will, Dellix used the spell against the Silent Soldiers. [The Spiral War]
